description: An accepted client that never finishes a newline-delimited request can block read_line forever, preventing new clients from being served and defeating idle shutdown. The daemon needs a request read timeout or equivalent connection isolation.

notes.author: darin@book
notes.content: Audit: verified in /Users/darin/Projects/raql on jj change de8865016485. Accepted daemon connections now have a bounded request read timeout, so half-open clients time out instead of wedging the accept loop or defeating idle shutdown. Verification: cargo test -p raql-daemon && cargo test -p raql-host-ra && cargo test --test cli_daemon_cutover -- --nocapture && cargo test --test cli_strict_runtime -- --nocapture.

title: Prevent half-open clients from wedging the daemon accept loop
